key_terms: The connected sources, operators and sinks of a Flink job, split into parallel subtasks for execution.
The Flink process that coordinates a job, schedules its subtasks and triggers checkpoints.
A Flink worker process that runs subtasks in its task slots and exchanges records with other subtasks.
Whether a source eventually ends. A bounded file can run through streaming operators, so boundedness is separate from the API or execution mode.
One parallel instance of an operator that a TaskManager executes.
evidence: Project-only actual product commands with independent fixture oracles. Source preparation, native runtime observations and restart evidence are recorded separately in the workshop qualification ledger.
